_comment: Resource broker project profiles. Copy this file to broker.config.json (gitignored) and fill in your real values. One key per project. The broker provisions an isolated workspace per worker: own git worktree + deterministic port by index. The 'db' and 'redis' blocks are OPTIONAL — include 'db' only if you want a per-worker Postgres database (cloned from a template); include 'redis' only if you want a per-worker logical DB. With neither, you still get worktree + port isolation. maxWorkers caps concurrent workers (default 16). workerTimeoutHours is the default age (in hours) after which 'cleanup-stale' frees a slot whose worker never ran 'free' — protects disk/DB/worktrees from leaks (default 12).
